title: Between Two Cultures: Reading Germany and India Without Judging Either
author: Intellectual Encounters editorial project
subject: Anthropology · Culture & cross-cultural life
description: A field guide to the culture gap you live inside — what "culture" even is, why Germans and Indians encode time, hierarchy, directness and respect so differently, and how to build a hybrid identity without betraying either side.
